Note 3 : The two subjects may include: (i) 2 elective subjects; or (ii) 1 elective subject and Mathematics (Extended Part) Module I or Module II or Other Language subjects (A2 or above in French / German / Spanish; or N3 or above in Japanese; or Grade 3 or above in Korean; or Grade E or above in Urdu). (iii) For Integrated Science or Combined Science subject(s) taken in 2023 or before, a Level 3 or above will be considered as an unspecified elective subject where applicable. cuhkAdmission.introduction: Unlock the secrets of the universe with our Enrichment Stream in Theoretical Physics Physics is the study of basic regularities behind various complex phenomena in the physical world. The objects of study range from the tiniest building blocks in nature, such as quarks in a proton, to the largest, such as the universe, of which our solar system is a minute part. Our programme offers a solid physics curriculum for young talented people with a special interest in theoretical studies and research. It provides not only rigorous training on fundamental concepts, but also numerous opportunities in research, exchange and internship. The Stream features strong mentorship and is designed for students interested in pursuing postgraduate studies at the master’s and doctoral level upon graduation.

cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: The core curriculum provides a solid grasp of fundamental concepts, and analytical, numerical, computational, experimental and research skills. In addition to the core courses, students can choose from a pool of elective courses focusing on theoretical physics and mathematics. The programme is further supported by numerous learning and experiential activities, including small-group discussions and seminars, research projects, and exchange and internship opportunities.
